positionDecayDescription: Examination probability is 1/rank for 1-based rank. A listing at position 1 is examined with probability 1, at position 2 with probability 0.5, and so on.
clickModel: relevance x position decay; relevance = 0.03 + (1 - 0.03) x grade / 3
loggingPolicy: Chapter 2 (lexical + normalization) ranks every matching listing. Sessions examine the full list with 1/rank decay.
